test_command: Not runnable while the Editor is open. Instead: (1) csc compile check of runtime + test sources, (2) Python parse of edited .unity/.prefab YAML (see key_patterns), (3) re-read every edited YAML block.
verification_instructions: csc compile check must report 0 errors. Every edited Unity YAML file must still parse (python regex split on '--- !u!<class> &<fileID>' documents), every new fileID must be unique within the file, every new component must be listed in its GameObject m_Component list, and each new GameObject must be listed in its parent Transform m_Children and have m_Father set.
setup_instructions: Nothing to install. Do not launch Unity. Use PowerShell. The sandbox may deny shell writes inside the project folder: use the fs_write / str_replace tools for file edits instead of PowerShell redirection. python.exe (3.14) is on PATH for scripted YAML analysis.
environment_constraints: Unity Editor is open on the project: no batchmode, no PlayMode run. git commands fail under the sandbox ('unable to access C:/Users/Eduard/.gitconfig'), do not commit. Scene and prefab files are Unity YAML with LF line endings and no BOM: preserve that exactly (write with LF, no BOM). New .cs files need a .cs.meta with a unique 32-hex guid (copy format of Assets/Scripts/Cooking/PanSnap.cs.meta). The user hand-edited hand related assets and scene content: do not touch Assets/Hand, XR rig content, or unrelated scene objects. 11 binary files show as modified in git (Kitchen_set_color.png, [Free] Phone textures/fbx): leave them alone.
contribution_requirements: No contributing doc found. Follow style of existing scripts (m_ prefixed serialized private fields with [SerializeField] and [Tooltip], XML doc summary on classes, no namespaces, UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables usings). Comments in English in code. Documentation in Documentation/ is Romanian.
key_patterns: Runtime scripts: Assets/Scripts/Cooking/Pan.cs (FixedJoint sticking of Cookables, listens to interactable.selectEntered), Assets/Scripts/Cooking/PanSnap.cs (settles the pan on a burner when released; checks m_Interactable.isSelected and Body.isKinematic; says isKinematic must not be touched by it), Assets/Scripts/Stove/*.cs. Pan.prefab: Rigidbody mass 1.2, CollisionDetection 2 (ContinuousDynamic), Interpolate 1, XRGrabInteractable m_MovementType 2 (Instantaneous), m_ThrowOnDetach 1, colliders on child 'Colliders' (Base, 4 Walls, Handle), disabled BoxColliders 'Contents' and 'HeatSensor' used only as shapes. In the scene the 7 XRGrabInteractable objects use MovementType 2 (Instantaneous); 1 uses MovementType 0 and ThrowOnDetach 0 (probably a knob/other). XRGrabInteractable in Instantaneous mode makes the Rigidbody kinematic while held and teleports it to the hand, so a held object ignores walls, furniture and the stove: this is the root cause of 'pan goes through walls'. The XR Origin prefab has a CharacterController (radius 0.1, height 1.36, step offset 0.5) plus gravity, so the player body collides with walls.
